name: add_bookmark
title: Add Bookmark
description: Adds a bookmark to the currently selected data source. Bookmarks are visible in the ImHex GUI and can be used to mark and annotate interesting regions for human review.

address.description: Start address of the bookmarked region

size.description: Size of the bookmarked region in bytes

name.description: Name of the bookmark. Defaults to an auto-generated name

color.description: RGBA color of the bookmark, or 0 for the default color

id.description: Unique ID of the created bookmark
